shots.focal_element: Scrunch web app in a full browser window (new-brand setup form, then the Disney Plus Prompts dashboard) with a circular presenter webcam bubble and recorder control bar fixed bottom-left
shots.transition_other: none: video opens on this shot (anchors give no transition_in)
on_screen_text: Enter any domain or page URL to get started.
shots.typography: Native product UI text only, no added titles: small sentence-case and title-case sans-serif labels (regular weight body, semibold section headings like 'Personas', 'Competitors', 'Key Topics'), normal tracking, lowercase wordmark; looks like a system/Inter-style UI sans (low-confidence guess). Long persona description paragraphs and table cells are present but not quoted.
shots.what_happens: One continuous unedited webcam-plus-screen recording (0:00-1:51). In the frames visible to me the brand-creation form auto-fills from the Disney+ URL with a loader 'Retrieving competitors.' (keyframe ~0:54), then (~1:12-1:34) the presenter scrolls through generated Personas, Competitors and Key Topics chips while explaining them (w220-w268), clicks create (w273-w287), the page jumps to the populated Disney Plus Prompts dashboard (~1:34.5) with donut charts and a topic table that he describes (w292-w333), then he scrolls the table and opens the New Prompt control just before the shot ends (w334-w337).
shots.build_rebuild: Record the real app full-screen in a browser at 1280x720 with a circular webcam overlay pinned bottom-left (about 20% of frame height) and no cuts, zooms or added graphics; let page loads and scrolls play in real time under the voice-over.

shots.focal_element: Centered 'New Prompt' modal (question field, Persona and Tags dropdowns, checked platform list, disabled 'Create prompt' button) over a darkened dashboard, webcam bubble bottom-left
shots.transition_other: in-app modal open: the dashboard dims under a scrim as the dialog appears within the same continuous recording (shot detector split on the luminance drop)
on_screen_text: A realistic question that a user might ask an AI platform to find or evaluate products or services.
shots.typography: Native product UI: semibold sentence-case modal title, regular-weight small sans helper and label text, placeholder text in lighter weight, platform names in title case next to small brand icons and checkboxes, normal tracking; Inter-like sans (low-confidence guess).
shots.what_happens: The New Prompt modal sits open over the dimmed dashboard while the presenter says he can generate and build new prompts on the fly (w334-w353); nothing is typed and the cursor barely moves; at ~1:56 the modal closes and the bright Prompts dashboard returns, ending the shot.
shots.build_rebuild: Hold a static screen capture of a centered form modal over a 60%-dark scrim for about 5 s while the voice-over describes it, then close the modal to reveal the undimmed dashboard.
